summary: The installed checkout hook and repository closeout wrapper implement the approved refresh triggers.
findings: Real Git branch switches updated the graph and removed stale symbols. Ordinary commits and path checkouts skipped refresh. The closeout wrapper kept the task open on refresh failure and forwarded its original arguments on success. Main checkout refresh and a source-verified query passed.
residual_risks: Raw AgentPlane commands do not run the repository wrapper. Graphify emitted parser warnings on some existing TypeScript files, and AgentPlane doctor retained its existing hook shim warning.
